about.title: About PolyglotBugHunter-X
about.what_body: A multimodal agent for automated, authorized web security testing. It reads pages (text), looks at renders (image), and listens to uploads (audio) at the same time, then reports what it found with CVSS v3.1 scores and evidence you can re-check.
about.authorized_body: This tool sends real HTTP requests. Only point it at systems you own or have explicit written permission to test. Illegal in most jurisdictions without a scope document.
about.community_body: Found a bug class we miss? Open a Discussion or send a PR with a new payload. Every payload passes an automated safety check before it lands, so keep it non-destructive.
